whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text: Hi, welcome to the Holographic Studios. We've been teaching holography classes for over 40 years, so if you're interested in learning how to make a hologram, consider taking one of our classes. Our approach is that we want you to understand, not memorize a lot of terminology. We try to make it simple and fun here. At Holographic Studios, we have an approach to the three D's of holography. Depth, detail, and dimension. We want you to understand how to make a good hologram, just like you know how to make a good selfie. It's not about all the technical things, it's about understanding it. Our approach is to teach you in a way that you'll actually learn quickly and be able to do it at home. So, if you're interested, take one of our classes, click our website under the link below, and click the link below to learn more about holography. We're also looking forward to working with you. Thank you.
